name: 55313 · Buffalo, MN
findings: ZIP 55313 (Buffalo) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55313 (Buffalo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
